verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs say agent threads can subscribe to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals, and workflows support typed steps and branches. Together these give a first-party, event-driven path to automatic actions. However, no declarative rule-definition layer (event → condition → action) is documented, and a hands-on user found rules-based, non-LLM branching clunky enough to replace with custom code. missing for 10: an explicit user-definable trigger/rule configuration, documentation of how events start workflows or actions, and independent corroboration that event triggers work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
